Planlab.ai | | Product Engineer (Design) & Platform Engineer | ONSITE in London, UK | 100k-160k GBP + 0.25-0.75% Equity | Visa sponsorship We’re building AI coworkers for project scheduling, helping teams deliver complex construction and infrastructure projects. We’re hiring: - *Product Engineer (Design):* Design and build intuitive software for complex projects.
- *Platform Engineer:* Build our algorithms, infrastructure, shared components, agents and internal tooling. Earlier-career through senior applicants welcome, with ownership and support matched to your experience. Both roles offer the compensation above. Company rapidly growing, with 9 team members today. We value initiative, creativity, and ownership. For more information, including how to apply, see https://planlab.ai/jobs
